title: About gleam modules
text: 💡 Practical use cases: Herd simulation across livestock production systems combination demographic non-demographic pathways depends animals managed within livestock production system, rather livestock species alone. example: Demographic – Beef cow–calf system: breeding herd may represented using six demographic cohorts (FJ, FS, FA, MJ, MS, MA), covering calves, replacement heifers, breeding cows, bulls. Reproduction, mortality, age transitions, offtake determine stable herd structure. Non-demographic – Broiler production: Female (FN) male (MN) chickens may represented defined productive phases, chick placement slaughter, without explicitly modelling reproduction demographic age transitions. Annual animal entries, productive phase durations, mortality determine average stock offtake. Non-demographic – Commercial laying hens: Laying hens may represented using female non-demographic cohort (FN), phase 1 corresponding pullet rearing phase 2 egg-laying period. Annual entries, phase durations, mortality determine average stock, offtake represents hens removed end productive cycle. pathways – Specialized dairy system calf fattening: dairy breeding herd replacement animals may represented demographic cohorts, selected calves transferred specialized fattening facilities may represented non-demographic cohorts. demographic module estimates juvenile flows entering fattening pathway, non-demographic module calculates stock offtake productive cycle. examples illustrate possible configurations rather fixed classifications. livestock species may represented using either pathway , depending production system available data. following examples use dedicated cohort- herd-level CSV files execution mode. what: Metabolic Energy Requirements and Ration Intake Module
title: About gleam modules
text: See run_metabolic_energy_req_module() full documentation. Computes cohort-level daily energy requirements (MJ/head/day) feed dry matter intake (kg DM/head/day) applying IPCC Tier 2 energy partitioning functions. Energy requirements expressed net energy (NE) CTL, BFL, SHP, GTS, metabolizable energy () CML, PGS, CHK. module computes following energy partitions: Maintenance — calc_metabolic_energy_req_maintenance() Activity — calc_metabolic_energy_req_activity() Growth — calc_metabolic_energy_req_growth() Lactation — calc_metabolic_energy_req_lactation() Pregnancy — calc_metabolic_energy_req_pregnancy() Work (draught power; CTL, BFL, CML ) — calc_metabolic_energy_req_work() Fibre production (SHP, GTS, CML ) — calc_metabolic_energy_req_fibre() Egg deposition (CHK ) — calc_metabolic_energy_req_eggs() chickens (CHK), model distinguishes reproductive eggs (used breeding) food eggs (produced human consumption). Reproductive eggs: Egg production energy requirements always calculated adult females (FA), based reproductive_rate. Food eggs: Energy requirements food-egg production calculated is_egg_producing = TRUE. option available adult females (FA) non-demographic females (FN) productive phase 2. Annual food-egg production per hen specified egg_human_consumption_yield (eggs/hen/year). Total energy requirements aggregated using calc_total_metabolic_energy_req(), dry matter intake derived using calc_ration_intake() dividing total energy requirement diet energy density.

title: About gleam modules
text: See run_nitrogen_balance_module() full documentation. Computes cohort-level daily nitrogen intake, retention, excretion (kg N/head/day) following IPCC Tier 2 approach. following calculation sequence applied: Daily nitrogen intake computed ration_intake ration_nitrogen using calc_nitrogen_intake(). Daily nitrogen retention (body tissues products growth, pregnancy, milk, eggs) computed using calc_nitrogen_retention(). Daily nitrogen excretion computed intake minus retention using calc_nitrogen_excretion(). module appends nitrogen_intake, nitrogen_retention, nitrogen_excretion cohort table (kg N/head/day), preserving supplied phase identifiers downstream manure calculations.

title: About gleam modules
text: See run_emissions_manure_module() full documentation. Computes cohort-level greenhouse gas emissions manure management systems (MMS) following IPCC Tier 2 methodology, using volatile solids (VS), MMS allocation fractions, MMS-specific emission factors. herd_id, set MMS identifiers must consistent manure_management_system_fraction manure_management_system_factors tables. nondemo_productive_phase_id optional manure fraction table. omitted entirely NA, fractions matched herd_id cohort_short reused phase cohort. fractions specify phases, cohort table must also contain phase identifier, matching includes nondemo_productive_phase_id. Input cohort rows phase identifiers preserved results. following calculation sequence applied: Volatile solids (VS) excretion computed feed ration nutritional parameters (digestibility, urinary energy, ash) using calc_volatile_solids() (IPCC 2006/2019, Eq. 10.24). Methane (CH₄) emissions manure management computed VS MMS-specific factors (MCF B₀), reported MMS group (pasture, burned, ) using calc_ch4_manure() (IPCC 2006/2019, Eq. 10.23). Direct N₂O emissions computed nitrogen excretion MMS-specific EF3 values, reported MMS group using calc_n2o_manure_direct() (IPCC 2006/2019, Eq. 10.25). Volatilisation-driven N₂O MMS-specific nitrogen losses (FracGas) EF4 using calc_n2o_manure_volatilization() (IPCC 2006/2019, Eq. 10.26–10.28). Leaching/runoff-driven N₂O MMS-specific nitrogen losses (FracLeach) EF5 using calc_n2o_manure_leaching() (IPCC 2006/2019, Eq. 10.27–10.29). Total N₂O (direct + indirect) summed MMS group using calc_n2o_manure_total(). returned cohort table contains volatile_solids methane nitrous oxide emission columns pasture, burned, MMS groups. Emission values expressed kg gas/head/day; herd totals assessment period calculated aggregation module.

Computes cohort-level production outputs assessment period combining cohort-level herd structure inputs herd-level production parameters. module returns milk, fibre, meat, food-egg outputs cohort. following calculation sequence applied: Milk outputs (raw mass, protein, fat-protein-corrected milk — FPCM) computed using calc_milk_production(). title: About gleam modules
text: See run_allocation_module() full documentation. pipeline consists following steps: Meat — calc_meat_allocation_energy() Milk — calc_milk_allocation_energy() Fibre — calc_fibre_allocation_energy() Work (draught power) — calc_work_allocation_energy() Eggs — calc_egg_allocation_energy() five cohort-level energy terms, including egg_allocation_energy, aggregated herd level using calc_cohort_to_herd_aggregation(). title: About gleam modules
text: See run_aggregation_module() full documentation. final step GLEAM pipeline. generates final herd-level results aggregating key cohort-level outputs, scaling variables assessment duration, allocating emissions commodities, converting CH₄ N₂O emissions CO₂-equivalents (CO₂eq) using selected 100-year Global Warming Potential (GWP-100) factors. following calculation sequence applied: Cohort-level variables reshaped wide long format. Variables classified "Feed", "NitrogenBalance", "Production", "Emissions". Cohort totals calculated using calc_cohort_totals(). Production variables retained provided already cover cohort assessment period. Daily per-head emissions, feed intake, nitrogen balance variables multiplied cohort_stock_size simulation_duration. Feed emission factors additionally multiplied ration_intake divided 1000 convert grams kilograms gas. Cohort totals aggregated herd level using calc_cohort_to_herd_aggregation(). Herd-level emissions merged commodity allocation shares. Emissions allocated commodities using calc_allocated_emissions(). Gas type (CH₄, N₂O, CO₂) identified emission variable name. Allocated emissions converted CO₂eq using calc_co2eq() selected GWP-100 option (AR4, AR5, AR6). Final output tables produced summarising herd-level results emissions, feed, production, nitrogen balance.

title: Overview of 'gleam' R Package
text: gleam R package implements core computational engine Global Livestock Environmental Assessment Model (GLEAM), developed Food Agriculture Organization United Nations (FAO). provides modular, transparent, reproducible framework quantifying greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions livestock supply chains using Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) approach based IPCC Tier 2 methodology. package covers seven livestock species: cattle (CTL), buffalo (BFL), camels (CML), sheep (SHP), goats (GTS), pigs (PGS), chickens (CHK). estimates emissions enteric fermentation, manure management, feed production, allocates livestock commodities (meat, milk, fibre, work) using biophysical energy-based allocation framework consistent ISO 14044, LEAP guidelines IDF Global Carbon Footprint Standard. package part broader GLEAM ecosystem, includes interactive web applications, dashboards, data infrastructure, capacity-building tools. vignette provides overview R package specifically; brief description wider ecosystem given GLEAM Ecosystem. Species currently covered GLEAM

code: library(gleam) library(data.table)  # ---- Load sample data from inst/extdata ---- path <- system.file("extdata/run_gleam_examples", package = "gleam")  cohort_dt      <- fread(file.path(path, "master_chrt_lvl_no_structure_mixed_data.csv")) herd_dt        <- fread(file.path(path, "master_hrd_lvl_mixed_data.csv")) rations_dt     <- fread(file.path(path, "feed_rations_share_chrt.csv")) feed_params_dt <- fread(file.path(path, "feed_quality.csv")) feed_emis_dt   <- fread(file.path(path, "feed_emission_factors.csv")) mms_frac_dt    <- fread(file.path(path, "manure_management_system_fraction.csv")) mms_fact_dt    <- fread(file.path(path, "manure_management_system_factors.csv"))  # ---- Run the full GLEAM pipeline ---- results <- run_gleam(   has_herd_structure                = FALSE,   run_demographic                   = TRUE,   run_nondemographic                = TRUE,   cohort_level_data                 = cohort_dt,   herd_level_data                   = herd_dt,   feed_rations                      = rations_dt,   feed_params                       = feed_params_dt,   feed_emissions                    = feed_emis_dt,   manure_management_system_fraction = mms_frac_dt,   manure_management_system_factors  = mms_fact_dt,   simulation_duration               = 365,   global_warming_potential_set      = "AR6" )  # ---- Inspect results ---- print(results$cohort_level_results) print(results$herd_level_results) print(results$allocation_long) print(results$aggregation_results$results_emissions)

title: Overview of 'gleam' R Package
text: Livestock agrifood systems GLEAM system boundary GLEAM applies cradle--processing-point Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) framework. system boundary encompasses: Upstream processes: feed crop pasture production, fertilizer input production, feed processing. -farm processes: animal husbandry, enteric fermentation, manure management, -farm energy use. Downstream processes: primary processing, storage, transport livestock products. Note: current R package implements -farm emission modules (metabolic energy requirements, enteric emissions, manure management emissions, production outputs, biophysical allocation). Feed production emissions computed using emission factors per feed component. Downstream processing modules development.

text: ratio_m3CH4_to_kgCH4 Numeric. Conversion factor used convert methane (CH4) volumetric unit (m3) mass unit (kg). value represents density methane. defaults 0.67 kg/m3. volatile_solids Numeric. Total volatile solids (VS) excreted per animal per day, representing organic material livestock manure consisting biodegradable non-biodegradable fractions (kg VS/head/day). ... variable number manure management system (MMS) arguments. MMS must provided named numeric vector exactly following fields: manure_management_system_fraction Numeric. Fraction total manure excreted animals given herd cohort handled specific manure management system. Values ranges 0 1. sum fractions herd_id must equal 1. methane_conversion_factor_mcf Numeric. Methane conversion factor represents portion degree maximum methane producing capacity (\(B_0\)) effectively achieved within specific manure management system. represents extent theoretical methane yield realized based management practices environmental conditions, specifically temperature system, retention time organic material, degree anaerobic conditions present. value theoretically ranges 0 100 percent. Default values can selected Table 10.17 IPCC guidelines (IPCC 2006, 2019). ch4_max_producing_capacity_bo Numeric. Maximum methane producing capacity (\(B_0\)) manure management systems (m3 CH4 / kg VS). value region- species-specific, represents theoretical maximum methane yield per unit volatile solids.. Default values may selected Table 10.16 (IPCC, 2019) Tables 10A-4 10A-9 (IPCC, 2006). title: Calculate methane (CH4) emissions from manure management systems — calc_ch4_manure
text: calculation follows structure IPCC Equation 10.23 methane (CH4) emission factors manure management. IPCC formulation, emissions determined combining: daily volatile solids excretion (volatile_solids) - see calc_volatile_solids, maximum methane-producing capacity (b0), methane conversion factor (mcf) manure management system, fraction manure handled system (manure_management_system_fraction). Applying IPCC conversion factor m3 CH4 kg CH4 (0.67), daily methane emissions calculated : $$   CH4 =   volatile\_solids \times b0 \times 0.67 \times   \sum \left( \frac{mcf}{100} \times manure\_management\_system\_fraction \right) $$ summation taken manure management systems included calculation. Results expressed daily resolution (kg CH4/head/day), consistent Equation 10.23 adapting original annual formulation daily basis. function part run_emissions_manure_module().

title: Calculate metabolic energy requirements for fibre production — calc_metabolic_energy_req_fibre
text: component follows IPCC Tier 2 partitioning approach applied fibre-producing species relevant cohorts, assumed FA, FS, MA, MS, FN, MN. Species-specific approach: SHP GTS (IPCC, 2006; IPCC, 2019): sheep goats, fibre production energy calculated assuming fixed net energy cost \(24\) MJ per kilogram fibre produced. Annual fibre production converted daily requirement : $$ metabolic\_energy\_req\_fibre = \frac{24 \times fibre\_yield\_year}{365} $$ : \(fibre\_yield\_year\) annual fibre production (kg/head/year), \(24\) net energy requirement per kilogram fibre (MJ/kg fibre), division \(365\) converts annual production daily basis. CML (AFRC, 1998; Cannas et al., 2007): camels, fibre energy requirements first calculated net energy basis converted metabolizable energy using net--metabolizable energy efficiency coefficient: $$ metabolic\_energy\_req\_fibre = \frac{24}{0.43} \times \frac{fibre\_yield\_year}{365} $$ : \(24\) net energy requirement per kilogram fibre (MJ/kg fibre), \(0.43\) efficiency conversion metabolizable energy net energy fibre production (fraction), \(fibre\_prod\) annual fibre production per animal (kg/head/year), \(365\) convert annual production daily basis. efficiency coefficient \(0.43\) adopted analogy goats, assuming dietary metabolizability approximately 0.55, following AFRC guidance synthesis Cannas et al. (2007). species: Fibre production energy assumed zero. function part run_metabolic_energy_req_module().

title: Calculate metabolic energy requirements for growth — calc_metabolic_energy_req_growth
text: function follows IPCC Tier 2 energy partitioning approach applies species-specific equations growth energy requirements. general, growth energy computed growing cohorts (FJ, FS, MJ, MS, FN, MN); implementation, growth set 0 adult cohorts (FA, MA). Species-specific approach: CTL BFL (NRC, 1996; IPCC, 2006; IPCC, 2019) Growth energy computed using growth coefficient \(cgro\) differs castrated intact males. male cohorts, \(cgro\) calculated weighted average using offtake_rate, assuming animals removed herd castrated animals remaining cohort intact. SHP GTS (Gibbs et al., 2002; AFRC, 1993; IPCC, 2006; IPCC, 2019) sheep goats, growth energy calculated using linear formulation coefficients \(\) \(b\) (MJ/kg live weight). male cohorts, coefficients differ castrated intact males; model computes weighted average using offtake_rate, assuming offtaken animals castrated. CML (Al-Jassim, 2019) Growth energy represented using simplified linear relationship daily weight gain. PGS (NRC, 1998) pigs, growth assumed consist exclusively protein tissue fat tissue, growth energy requirements expressed metabolizable energy (). growth energy coefficient \(cgro\) (MJ/kg live weight) calculated : \(     cgro =     prot\_tissue\_frac \times meat\_protein \times meat\_protein\_energy     + (1 - prot\_tissue\_frac) \times fat\_adipose\_tissue_frac \times meat\_fat\_energy   \) Total metabolizable energy required growth : \(metabolic\_energy\_req\_growth = daily\_weight\_gain \times cgro\) : \(cgro\) growth energy coefficient (MJ/kg live weight), prot_tissue_frac = 0.65 fraction protein tissue daily weight gain, meat_protein = 0.23 fraction protein protein tissue, meat_protein_energy = 54.0 cost protein deposition (MJ/kg protein), fat_adipose_tissue_frac = 0.90 fraction fat adipose tissue, meat_fat_energy = 52.3 cost fat deposition (MJ/kg fat). CHK (Sakomura, 2004) Chicken growth energy calculated : $$metabolic\_energy\_req\_growth = daily\_weight\_gain \times cgro \times 1000$$ \(daily\_weight\_gain\) expressed kg/head/day \(cgro\) expressed MJ/g. factor 1000 converts kilograms live-weight gain grams. following values used, based Table 3 Sakomura (2004): FA MA: \(cgro = 0.0299\) (average values "Laying hen" "Broiler breeder hen") FN is_egg_producing = TRUE: \(cgro = 0.0279\) (value "Laying hen") FN is_egg_producing = FALSE: \(cgro = 0.0221\) (average values, excluding "Male broiler", "Laying hen", "Broiler breeder hen") MN: \(cgro = 0.0173\) (average values "Male broiler") FS, FJ, MS, MJ: \(cgro = 0.0191\) (average values, excluding "Laying hen" "Broiler breeder hen") function part run_metabolic_energy_req_module().

title: Calculate metabolic energy requirements for lactation — calc_metabolic_energy_req_lactation
text: approach follows IPCC Tier 2 partitioning method applies species-specific equations lactation energy requirements function quantity milk produced species-specific energy cost per unit milk. Requirements calculated cohort = FA (adult females) scaled proportion lactating animals (lactating_females_fraction) reproducing females (parturition_rate) within cohort. Species-specific approach: CTL, BFL, CML, SHP GTS: Total milk production includes: milk extracted human consumption (milk_yield) milk consumed directly offspring (milk_for_offspring) general form, lactation energy computed : $$ metabolic\_energy\_req\_lactation = (milk\_yield \times lactating\_females\_fraction + milk\_for\_offspring) \times energy\_milk $$ : energy_milk species-specific coefficient representing net energy cost producing one kilogram milk (MJ/kg milk). Species-specific values energy_milk : CTL, BFL: estimated function milk fat content, \(1.47 + 0.40 \times (milk\_fat\_fraction \times 100)\) (NRC, 1989), CML: \(4.063\) (Wardeh, 2004), SHP: \(4.6\) (AFRC, 1993), GTS: \(3.0\) (AFRC, 1998). milk_for_offspring daily amount milk required rear offspring across year (kg/day). calculated assuming 5 kg milk required kilogram live-weight gain weaning: $$ milk\_for\_offspring = \frac{parturition\_rate \times 5 \times (weaning\_weight - birth\_weight)}{365} $$ SHP GTS, milk_for_offspring multiplied litter_size account multiple offspring per birth. PGS (NRC, 1998): Lactation energy accounts milk consumed directly offspring (milk_for_offspring), adjusted fraction reproductive cycle spent lactation (cadj): $$ \begin{aligned} metabolic\_energy\_req\_lactation &= litter\_size \times (1 - 0.5 \times death\_rate\_juvenile) \times \\ & \left( \frac{0.02059 \times (weaning\_weight - birth\_weight) \times 1000} {lactation\_duration} - \frac{0.3766}{0.67} \right) \times cadj \end{aligned} $$ : \(0.02059\) coefficient lactation energy requirement (MJ/g live weight), \(0.3766\) coefficient sow weight loss lactation (MJ/head/day), \(0.67\) efficiency conversion dietary intake milk energy (fraction), \(cadj\) fraction reproductive cycle spent lactation: $$   cadj = \frac{lactation\_duration}{non\_productive\_duration + pregnancy\_duration + lactation\_duration}   $$ function part run_metabolic_energy_req_module().

title: Calculate metabolic energy requirements for maintenance — calc_metabolic_energy_req_maintenance
text: approach follows IPCC Tier 2 partitioning method applies: \(metabolic\_energy\_req\_maintenance = cmain \times average\_weight^{0.75}\) \(cmain\) category-specific coefficient (MJ/day/kg\(^{0.75}\)) reflects basal metabolic requirements varies species, physiological status, sex. selected cohorts, \(cmain\) computed weighted average account : CTL, BFL: lactating vs. non-lactating females CTL, BFL, SHP: intact vs. castrated males - Offtaken animals assumed castrated SHP: animals vs. one year age Specific coefficients species cohort: CTL BFL (NRC, 1996; AFRC, 1993): FA: \(cmain = 0.386 \times lactating\_females\_fraction + 0.322 \times (1 - lactating\_females\_fraction)\) FS, FJ, MJ, FN, MN: \(cmain = 0.322\) MA, MS: \(cmain = 0.322 \times offtake\_rate + 0.370 \times (1 - offtake\_rate)\) CML (Wardeh, 2004): cohorts: \(cmain = 0.435\) GTS (AFRC, 1993): cohorts: \(cmain = 0.315\) SHP (AFRC, 1993): FA: \(cmain = 0.217\) FJ: \(cmain = 0.236\) FS: \(cmain = 0.236 \times (365/age\_first\_parturition) +          0.217 \times ((age\_first\_parturition - 365)/age\_first\_parturition)\) MA: \(cmain = 0.217 \times offtake\_rate + (0.217 \times 1.15) \times (1 - offtake\_rate)\) MJ: \(cmain = 0.236 \times offtake\_rate + (0.236 \times 1.15) \times (1 - offtake\_rate)\) MS: \(cmain =       (0.217 \times offtake\_rate + (0.217 \times 1.15) \times (1 - offtake\_rate)) \times ((age\_first\_parturition - 365)/age\_first\_parturition) +       (0.236 \times offtake\_rate + (0.236 \times 1.15) \times (1 - offtake\_rate)) \times (365/age\_first\_parturition)\) PGS (NRC, 1998): cohorts: \(cmain = 0.4435\) CHK (Sakomura, 2004; Neme et al. 2005): Adult laying cohorts (MA plus CHK cohort is_egg_producing = TRUE): $$   metabolic\_energy\_req\_maintenance =   average\_weight^{0.75} \times   \left(0.6935 - 0.0099 \times average\_annual\_temperature \right)   $$ Juvenile subadult cohorts (FJ, FS, MJ, MS, MN, non-laying FN phase 1): $$   metabolic\_energy\_req\_maintenance =   average\_weight^{0.75} \times   \left(0.3866 + 0.0282 \times   (lower\_critical\_temperature - average\_annual\_temperature) \right),   \quad average\_annual\_temperature < lower\_critical\_temperature   $$ $$   metabolic\_energy\_req\_maintenance =   average\_weight^{0.75} \times   \left(0.3866 + 0.0037 \times   (average\_annual\_temperature - lower\_critical\_temperature) \right),   \quad average\_annual\_temperature \ge lower\_critical\_temperature   $$ function part run_metabolic_energy_req_module().

title: Calculate metabolic energy requirements for pregnancy — calc_metabolic_energy_req_pregnancy
text: component follows IPCC Tier 2 partitioning framework applied female cohorts (FA FS). Pregnancy energy (metabolic_energy_req_pregnancy) represents additional energy required support gestation mammals. Requirements computed fraction maintenance energy adjusted reflect reproductive activity within cohort: FA, requirements scaled annual parturition rate (parturition_rate) (applicable) fraction reproductive cycle spent gestation (pregnancy_duration/(pregnancy_duration+lactation_duration+non_productive_duration)). FS, fraction animals assumed reach reproductive age within cohort; requirements therefore scaled proportion remaining cohort (\(1 - offtake\_rate\)) share cohort duration spent pregnant (pregnancy_duration/cohort_duration_days). General form $$ metabolic\_energy\_req\_pregnancy = metabolic\_energy\_req\_maintenance \times c_{preg} \times S $$ \(c_{preg}\) species-specific pregnancy coefficient, \(S\) scaling term depends cohort (FA vs FS). \(metabolic\_energy\_req\_maintenance\) can calculated using calc_metabolic_energy_req_maintenance() Specific coefficients species cohort: CTL BFL (IPCC, 2006, 2019): Pregnancy energy approximated \(10\%\) maintenance energy. FA: $$   \begin{aligned}   metabolic\_energy\_req\_pregnancy &=   0.10 \times metabolic\_energy\_req\_maintenance \times parturition\_rate \times \\   & \frac{pregnancy\_duration}{365}   \end{aligned} $$ FS: $$   \begin{aligned}   metabolic\_energy\_req\_pregnancy &=   0.10 \times metabolic\_energy\_req\_maintenance \times \\   & \frac{pregnancy\_duration}{cohort\_duration\_days} \times   (1 - offtake\_rate)   \end{aligned} $$ CML (Wardeh, 2004): Pregnancy energy estimated \(12\%\) maintenance energy. FA: $$   metabolic\_energy\_req\_pregnancy =   0.12 \times metabolic\_energy\_req\_maintenance \times parturition\_rate   $$ FS: $$   metabolic\_energy\_req\_pregnancy =   0.12 \times metabolic\_energy\_req\_maintenance \times   \frac{pregnancy\_duration}{cohort\_duration\_days} \times (1 - offtake\_rate)   $$ SHP GTS (IPCC 2006; 2019): Pregnancy energy calculated litter-size-dependent fraction maintenance energy (\(c_{preg}\)). FA: $$   \begin{aligned}   metabolic\_energy\_req\_pregnancy &=   metabolic\_energy\_req\_maintenance \times c_{preg} \times parturition\_rate \times \\   & \frac{pregnancy\_duration}{365}   \end{aligned}   $$ \(c_{preg}\) : $$   c_{preg} =   \left\{   \begin{array}{ll}   0.077 \times (2 - litter\_size) + 0.126 \times (litter\_size - 1), & 1 \le litter\_size \le 2 \\   0.150, & litter\_size > 2   \end{array}   \right.   $$ FS: single-birth coefficient used (\(c_{preg}=0.077\)) scaled proportion reproductive individuals cohort: $$   \begin{aligned}   metabolic\_energy\_req\_pregnancy &=   0.12 \times metabolic\_energy\_req\_maintenance \times \\   & \frac{pregnancy\_duration}{cohort\_duration\_days} \times \\   & (1 - offtake\_rate)   \end{aligned} $$ PGS (NRC, 1998): Pregnancy energy expressed using gestation coefficient \(c_{gest}\) (MJ/piglet), default \(c_{gest}=0.14985\). FA: $$ \begin{aligned} metabolic\_energy\_req\_pregnancy &= c_{gest} \times litter\_size \times \\ & \frac{pregnancy\_duration}{ non\_productive\_duration + pregnancy\_duration + lactation\_duration } \end{aligned} $$ FS: $$ \begin{aligned} metabolic\_energy\_req\_pregnancy &= c_{gest} \times litter\_size \times \\ & \frac{pregnancy\_duration}{cohort\_duration\_days} \times \\ & (1 - offtake\_rate) \end{aligned} $$ function part run_metabolic_energy_req_module().

title: Calculate indirect Nitrous Oxide (N2O) emissions from manure volatilization — calc_n2o_manure_volatilization
text: calculation follows Tier 2 methodology indirect N2O emissions manure management defined IPCC Guidelines Equations 10.26 (IPCC, 2006, 2019), 10.27 (IPCC, 2006) 10.28 (IPCC, 2019). IPCC formulation, indirect emissions atmospheric deposition volatilised nitrogen calculated : $$   N2O_{G(mm)} =   \frac{44}{28}   \sum_{S} \left(     N \times AWMS_S \times FracGas_{S} \times EF4   \right) $$ : \(N2O_G(mm)\) Indirect N2O emissions due volatilization N Manure Management. \(44/28\) Conversion factor N2O-N N2O. \(N\) Nitrogen excreted (kg N). \(AWMS_S\) Fraction excreted nitrogen managed manure management system \(S\). \(FracGas_{S}\) Fraction nitrogen volatilised NH3–N NOx–N manure management system \(S\). \(EF4\) Emission factor indirect N2O emissions atmospheric deposition (kg N2O-N per kg NH3–N + NOx–N). implementation, calculations performed daily, per-head resolution using nitrogen_excretion (kg N/head/day): $$ \begin{aligned} N_2O &= nitrogen\_excretion \times ratio\_N2ON\_to\_N2O \times \\ & \sum_{S} \left( manure\_management\_system\_fraction \times nitrogen\_fracgas \times n2o\_ef4 \right) \end{aligned} $$ function part run_emissions_manure_module().

title: Calculate daily nitrogen retention — calc_nitrogen_retention
text: Species-specific nitrogen retention calculations applied. CTL, BFL, SHP, GTS, CML: Nitrogen retained products tissues computed consistent process described Technical paper MPI (Ministry Primary Industries (MPI), 2025), nitrogen retention calculated sum : nitrogen secreted milk, nitrogen retained live weight gain (tissue), nitrogen retained fibre (fibre-producing species). Coefficients nitrogen content deposited tissue, fibre, milk derived Chapter 5 (Nitrogen Excretion) MPI Technical paper. following constants used: Tissue nitrogen content (tissue_n) CTL BFL: 0.0326 kg N/kg live weight SHP, GTS CML: 0.026 kg N/kg live weight Fibre nitrogen content (fibre_n) SHP, GTS CML: 0.134 kg N/kg fibre Milk nitrogen content (milk_n): CTL, BFL, SHP, GTS CML: derived milk_protein_fraction using protein--nitrogen conversion factor 6.25 kg protein/kg nitrogen PGS Nitrogen retention calculated following IPCC (2019) Tier 2 equations swine (Equations 10.33A 10.33B). Nitrogen retention includes nitrogen retained : live weight gain (tissue), reproductive outputs (conceptus weaned offspring). implementation: Nitrogen content live weight gain assumed 0.025 kg N/kg live weight. Protein digestibility fraction assumed  0.98 (dimensionless). breeding cohorts, reproductive component represented annual nitrogen retention conceptus weaned offspring, expressed daily average distributing annual value uniformly year (365 days). constant factor  0.806 (dimensionless) applied piglets' live weight gain correct higher nitrogen content per unit live weight gain, following IPCC (2019). CHK: Nitrogen retention includes growth egg deposition. Reproductive eggs included FA regardless food-egg flag. Eggs human consumption included is_egg_producing = TRUE: $$nitrogen\_retention = growth\_component + egg\_component$$ : $$growth\_component = daily\_weight\_gain \times 0.032$$ : $$ egg\_component = (human\_consumption\_eggs\_head\_day + reproductive\_eggs\_head\_day) \times egg\_average\_weight \times 0.02 $$ Human-consumption eggs per head per day equal egg_human_consumption_yield / 365 food-egg flag true, zero otherwise. Reproductive eggs per head per day equal parturition_rate / 365 FA, zero cohorts. coefficient 0.032 represents nitrogen retained live-weight gain (kg N/kg live weight), following Lessire (2004). coefficient 0.02 represents nitrogen content egg mass (kg N/kg egg mass), based egg protein composition summarized Caffa et al. (2025). implemented poultry pathway, food-egg component activated cohort-level is_egg_producing flag. Validation restricts flag demographic laying hens (FA) non-demographic FN phase 2 intensive layers modeled outside demographic structure. function part run_nitrogen_balance_module().

title: Calculate nondemographic cycle geometry — calc_nondemo_cycle_geometry
text: nondemographic production cycle can contain one two productive phases, followed optional resting period next cycle starts. function uses fixed 365-day time horizon horizon matches demographic herd simulation. cycle consists : Phase 1 (productive) length phase1_nondemo_duration Optional Phase 2 (productive) length phase2_nondemo_duration Optional rest cycles (productive phases next cycle starts) length rest_between_nondemo_cycles_duration total length one cycle calculated : $$ cycle\_length = phase1\_non\_demo\_duration + phase2\_non\_demo\_duration + rest\_between\_non\_demo\_cycles\_duration $$ number complete cycles fully contained within fixed time horizon : $$ number\_full\_non\_demo\_cycles = \left\lfloor \frac{time\_horizon}{cycle\_length} \right\rfloor $$ time remaining complete cycles allocated : $$ time\_remaining = time\_horizon - number\_full\_non\_demo\_cycles \times cycle\_length $$ time remaining full cycles allocated sequentially next cycle. First, remaining time used fill phase 1: $$ partial\_phase1\_nondemo\_duration = \min(time\_remaining,\ phase1\_non\_demo\_duration) $$ time left phase 1 : $$ time\_remaining2 = time\_remaining - partial\_phase1\_nondemo\_duration $$ : phase 2 exists (phase2_nondemo_duration > 0), phase 1 fully completed remaining time allocated phase 2: $$ partial\_phase2\_nondemo\_duration = \min(time\_remaining2,\ phase2\_non\_demo\_duration) $$ full cycle contributes one cycle start. addition, partial phase 1 present (.e. partial_phase1_nondemo_duration > 0), indicates new cycle started. Therefore: $$ total\_nondemo\_cycle\_starts\_to\_distribute = number\_full\_non\_demo\_cycles + (partial\_phase1\_nondemo\_duration > 0) $$ function part run_nondemographic_herd_module().

text: function converts phase-level mortality probability (death_rate_nondemo_phase) implied daily mortality probability assumption constant daily mortality throughout phase. implied daily mortality derived cumulative survival full phase duration (productive_phase_nondemo_duration) equal \(1 - death_rate_nondemo_phase\). Daily mortality calculated : $$ death\_rate\_daily\_nondemo = 1 - (1 - death_rate_nondemo_phase)^{1 / productive_phase_nondemo_duration} $$ corresponding daily survival probability : $$ survival\_rate\_daily\_nondemo = 1 - death\_rate\_daily\_nondemo $$ number simulated days limited total phase duration maximum number days allowed current simulation step: $$ time\_simulated\_nondemographic = \min(max_simulation_days_nondemo_phase,\ productive_phase_nondemo_duration) $$ End--phase stock calculated applying constant daily survival starting stock simulated period: $$ cohort\_stock\_nondemo_{end} = cohort\_stock\_nondemo\_start\_by\_phase \times survival\_rate\_daily\_nondemo^{time\_simulated\_nondemographic} $$ Equivalently: $$ cohort\_stock\_nondemo_{end} = cohort\_stock\_nondemo\_start\_by\_phase \times (1 - death\_rate\_daily\_nondemo)^{time\_simulated\_nondemographic} $$ productive_phase_nondemo_duration NULL less equal zero, function assumes productive phase simulated. case, mortality set zero, simulated time set zero, starting ending stock returned zero. rounding applied stock values. text: component follows IPCC Tier 2 partitioning approach calculation computed differently depending whether species energy requirements expressed net metabolizable energy. Species-specific approach: Energy requirements expressed net energy (CTL, BFL, SHP, GTS) CTL BFL: $$       metabolic\_energy\_req\_total =       \frac{         \left(           \frac{             metabolic\_energy\_req\_maintenance +             metabolic\_energy\_req\_activity +             metabolic\_energy\_req\_lactation +             metabolic\_energy\_req\_work +             metabolic\_energy\_req\_pregnancy           }{REM}         \right)         +         \left(           \frac{metabolic\_energy\_req\_growth}{REG}         \right)       }{ration\_digestibility\_fraction}     $$ SHP GTS: $$       metabolic\_energy\_req\_total =       \frac{         \left(           \frac{             metabolic\_energy\_req\_maintenance +             metabolic\_energy\_req\_activity +             metabolic\_energy\_req\_lactation +             metabolic\_energy\_req\_pregnancy           }{REM}         \right)         +         \left(           \frac{             metabolic\_energy\_req\_growth +             metabolic\_energy\_req\_fibre           }{REG}         \right)       }{ration\_digestibility\_fraction}     $$ Energy requirements expressed metabolizable energy (CML, PGS, CHK) species, total daily requirement computed direct sum relevant energy components (MJ/head/day). CML: $$       metabolic\_energy\_req\_total =       metabolic\_energy\_req\_maintenance +       metabolic\_energy\_req\_activity +       metabolic\_energy\_req\_lactation +       metabolic\_energy\_req\_work +       metabolic\_energy\_req\_fibre\_production +       metabolic\_energy\_req\_pregnancy +       metabolic\_energy\_req\_growth     $$ PGS: $$       metabolic\_energy\_req\_total =       metabolic\_energy\_req\_maintenance +       metabolic\_energy\_req\_activity +       metabolic\_energy\_req\_lactation +       metabolic\_energy\_req\_pregnancy +       metabolic\_energy\_req\_growth     $$ CHK: $$       metabolic\_energy\_req\_total =       metabolic\_energy\_req\_maintenance +       metabolic\_energy\_req\_activity +       metabolic\_energy\_req\_growth +       metabolic\_energy\_req\_egg\_deposition     $$ function part run_metabolic_energy_req_module().

title: Calculate Volatile Solids (VS) — calc_volatile_solids
text: IPCC recommends estimating volatile solids (VS) excretion feed intake digestibility country-specific average daily VS excretion rates available. core relationship provided IPCC Equation 10.24 (Volatile solids excretion rates), estimates daily VS excretion function : Gross energy intake (gross_energy_intake, MJ/day) Digestibility diet (ration_digestibility_fraction) Urinary energy expressed fraction GE (ration_urinary_energy_fraction) Ash content diet (ration_ash, fraction dry matter) conversion factor representing average gross energy content dry matter (18.45 MJ/kg DM) general structure Eq. 10.24 partitions gross energy intake digestible energy, urinary losses, ash, converts remaining organic matter volatile solids using energy density dry matter. Implementation note. function applies algebraically simplified formulation Equation 10.24 IPCC. implementation, function takes ration_intake directly input. can calculated upstream calc_ration_intake function energy requirements energy content diet. $$   dry\_matter\_intake = \frac{gross\_energy\_intake}{diet\_gross\_energy} $$ reflects use ration-specific energy content upstream avoids assuming fixed gross energy density 18.45 MJ/kg DM, IPCC default approach. volatile solids excretion calculated : $$ volatile\_solids = dry\_matter\_intake \times (1 - diet\_digestibility\_fraction + urinary\_energy\_fraction) \times (1 - diet\_ash) $$ resulting calculations algebraically equivalent IPCC approach fully consistent Equation 10.24. function part run_emissions_manure_module().

Includes emissions atmospheric deposition volatilised nitrogen (NH3 NOx) leaching runoff manure nitrogen (kg N2O/head/day). co2_ration_fertilizer Numeric. Diet-level average carbon dioxide (CO2) emission factor fertilizer manufacture feed production (g CO2/kg DM). co2_ration_pesticides Numeric. Diet-level average carbon dioxide (CO2) emission factor pesticide manufacture feed production (g CO2/kg DM). co2_ration_crop_activities Numeric. Diet-level average carbon dioxide (CO2) emission factor -field agricultural activities feed production (g CO2/kg DM). co2_ration_luc_nopeat Numeric. Diet-level average carbon dioxide (CO2) emission factor land-use change (excluding peatland drainage) feed production (g CO2/kg DM). co2_ration_luc_peat Numeric. Diet-level average carbon dioxide (CO2) emission factor  peatland drainage feed production (g CO2/kg DM). n2o_ration_fertilizer Numeric. Diet-level average nitrous oxide (N2O) emission factor fertilizer use feed production (g N2O/kg DM). n2o_ration_manure_applied Numeric. Diet-level average nitrous oxide (N2O) emission factor manure applied deposited soil feed production (g N2O/kg DM). n2o_ration_crop_residues Numeric. Diet-level average nitrous oxide (N2O) emission factor crop residues decomposition feed production (g N2O/kg DM). ch4_ration_rice Numeric. Diet-level average methane (CH4) emission factor rice cultivation feed production (g CH4/kg DM). allocation_herd_long data.table. Herd-level allocation table long format, typically generated run_allocation_module(), following data requirements: herd_id Character. Unique identifier herd, repeated cohort belonging herd. species_short Character. Code identifying livestock species. Supported values include PGS, CML, CTL, BFL, SHP, GTS variable_name Character. Names emission variables allocation applied (e.g., "ch4_enteric", "ch4_manure_pasture", "ch4_manure_burned", "ch4_manure_other", "n2o_manure_pasture_direct", "n2o_manure_burned_direct", "n2o_manure_other_direct", "n2o_manure_burned_indirect", "n2o_manure_pasture_indirect", "n2o_manure_other_indirect", "co2_ration_fertilizer", "co2_ration_pesticides", "co2_ration_crop_activities", "co2_ration_luc_nopeat", "co2_ration_luc_peat", "n2o_ration_fertilizer", "n2o_ration_manure_applied", "n2o_ration_crop_residues", "ch4_ration_rice") commodity_name Character. Length assessment period (days). global_warming_potential_set Character. Settings 100-year Global Warming Potential (GWP-100) conversion factors used express CH4 N2O emissions CO2eq. Must one : "AR6": IPCC Sixth Assessment Report (IPCC, 2021) - CH4 = 27, N2O = 273 "AR5_excluding_carbon_feedback": IPCC Fifth Assessment Report (excluding climate-carbon feedbacks) (IPCC, 2013) - CH4 = 28, N2O = 265 "AR5_including_carbon_feedback": IPCC Fifth Assessment Report (including climate-carbon feedbacks) (IPCC, 2013) - CH4 = 34, N2O = 298 "AR4": IPCC Fourth Assessment Report (IPCC, 2007) - CH4 = 25, N2O = 298 show_indicator Logical. title: Run Aggregation Module Pipeline — run_aggregation_module
text: function represents final step Global Livestock Environmental Assessment Model (GLEAM) computational pipeline run_gleam() performs following calculation sequence: Cohort-level variables reshaped wide long format. Variables classified "Feed", "NitrogenBalance", "Production", "Emissions". Cohort totals calculated using calc_cohort_totals(). Production variables retained provided, whereas emissions, feed, nitrogen balance variables scaled using cohort stock size simulation duration. Cohort totals aggregated herd level within herd_id x species_short x variable_type x variable_name group. Herd-level emissions merged commodity allocation shares allocation_herd_long. Emissions allocated commodities using calc_allocated_emissions(). Gas type identified emission variable name "CH4", "N2O", "CO2". Allocated CH4, N2O, CO2 emissions converted CO2-equivalents (CO2eq) using calc_co2eq() selected GWP-100 option. Final output tables produced summarizing herd-level results emissions, feed, production, nitrogen balance variables.

title: Run Allocation Module Pipeline — run_allocation_module
text: function implements allocation pipeline used derive biophysical allocation shares livestock commodities multifunctional production systems. approach follows IDF standard dairy sector, adapted livestock systems emissions apportioned among multiple products according physiological energy requirements. accordance ISO 14044:2006, known biophysical relationships may used assign shared inputs outputs production system individual products sub-units. function represents intermediate allocation module Global Livestock Environmental Assessment Model (GLEAM) computational pipeline run_gleam() performs following calculation sequence: Calculation cohort-level energy allocation terms meat, milk, fibre, work, eggs using calc_meat_allocation_energy, calc_milk_allocation_energy, calc_fibre_allocation_energy, calc_work_allocation_energy, calc_egg_allocation_energy. Aggregation cohort-level energy terms herd level using calc_cohort_to_herd_aggregation. Calculation herd-level allocation shares commodities using calc_allocation_shares. Reshaping allocation shares long format assignment shares emission sources using assign_allocation_shares. Commodity-specific allocation shares represent fraction total herd-level energy requirements attributable commodity. shares used assign emissions meat, milk, fibre, work, eggs, residual category "None". Emissions manure burned fuel manure deposited pasture allocated livestock commodities. flows assigned fully "None" accordance rules implemented assign_allocation_shares.

text: cohort_level_data data.table. Cohort-level input table following data requirement: herd_id Character. Unique identifier herd, repeated cohort belonging herd. species_short Character. Code identifying livestock species. Supported values include: PGS: pigs CML: camels CTL: cattle BFL: buffalo SHP: sheep GTS: goats CHK: chickens cohort_short Character. Sex- age-specific cohort code describing production stage animals. Supported values include: FA: adult females (age first parturition) FS: sub-adult females (weaning age first parturition) FJ: juvenile females (birth weaning) FN: non-demographic females MA: adult males (age first breeding) MS: sub-adult males (weaning age first breeding) MJ: juvenile males (birth weaning) MN: non-demographic males nondemo_productive_phase_id Numeric. Average digestibility feed ration, expressed ratio digestible (metabolizable, poultry) gross energy content (fraction). ration_gross_energy Numeric. Average gross energy content diet (MJ/kg DM). ration_intake Numeric. Average daily dry matter intake feed (kg DM/head/day). ch4_mitigation_factor Numeric. Optional. Multiplicative mitigation factor applied baseline enteric methane (CH4) emissions (dimensionless). provided, default value 1 (mitigation) used. Values lower 1 represent proportional reductions (e.g., 0.90 = 10% reduction). factor can represent mitigation measures direct effect enteric methane emissions, use feed additives methane inhibitors. show_indicator Logical. Default values can selected Table 11.3 IPCC Guidelines (IPCC 2006, 2019). nitrogen_fracleach Numeric. title: Run Emissions from Manure Module Pipeline — run_emissions_manure_module
text: function represents intermediate module Global Livestock Environmental Assessment Model (GLEAM) computational pipeline run_gleam() estimate emissions manure management systems (MMS) orchestrates cohort-level implementation IPCC manure management methodology. following calculation sequence applied: VS excretion computed nutritional parameters feed ration (digestibility, urinary energy, ash) using simplified formulation Equation 10.24 (IPCC 2006, 2019) - calc_volatile_solids Methane (CH4) emissions manure management computed VS MMS-specific factors (MCF B0) reported MMS group (pasture, burned, ), consistently Equation 10.23 (IPCC, 2006, 2019) - calc_ch4_manure Direct nitrous oxide (N2O) emissions manure management computed nitrogen excretion MMS-specific EF3 values, reported MMS group, consistently Equation 10.25 (IPCC, 2006, 2019) -  calc_n2o_manure_direct Indirect N2O emissions computed sum : volatilisation-driven N2O using MMS-specific nitrogen losses (FracGas) EF4, consistently Equations 10.26 (IPCC, 2006, 2019), 10.27 (IPCC, 2006), 10.28 (IPCC, 2019) - calc_n2o_manure_volatilization leaching/runoff-driven N2O using MMS-specific nitrogen losses (FracLeach) EF5, consistently Equations 10.28 (IPCC, 2006), 10.27 (IPCC, 2019), 10.29 (IPCC, 2006, 2019) - calc_n2o_manure_leaching Total N2O emissions aggregated MMS group (pasture, burned, ) - calc_n2o_manure_total manure_management_system_fraction omits nondemo_productive_phase_id, column contains missing values, fractions matched herd_id + cohort_short reused input phase. fractions specify phase identifiers, cohort_level_data must also contain phase column, matching uses herd_id + cohort_short + nondemo_productive_phase_id. Input rows supplied phase identifiers preserved output. approach corresponds Tier 2 implementation : VS derived ration-level inputs rather using fixed daily excretion defaults, emissions allocated across MMS categories using herd/cohort MMS fractions MMS-specific parameters.

title: Run Emissions from Feed Production Module Pipeline — run_emissions_ration_module
text: function represents intermediate module Global Livestock Environmental Assessment Model (GLEAM) computational pipeline run_gleam() estimate emissions feed production used animal's ration. function joins rations_share feed_emissions feed_id, uses species_short directly, computes ration-weighted emission factors cohort. following calculation sequence applied: Merge ration shares emission factors feed-component level using merge feed_id (left join: .x = TRUE). Compute feed-component contributions (row-wise) emission source multiplying ration share feed component (feed_ration_fraction) corresponding feed emission factor. contribution computed using specific helper (called = .): CO2 fertilizer: calc_co2_ration_fertilizer CO2 pesticides: calc_co2_ration_pesticides CO2 crop operations: calc_co2_ration_crop_activities CO2 land-use change (peat): calc_co2_ration_luc_nopeat CO2 land-use change (peat): calc_co2_ration_luc_peat N2O fertilizer: calc_n2o_ration_fertilizer N2O manure applied: calc_n2o_ration_manure N2O crop residues: calc_n2o_ration_crop_residues CH4 rice cultivation: calc_ch4_ration_rice Aggregate cohort-level diet emission factors summing feed-component contributions across feeds within group (herd_id, species_short, cohort_short) within nondemo_productive_phase_id column provided. emission source, cohort-level dietary emission factors computed : $$   \mathrm{diet\_ef} =   \sum_{=1}^{n}   \left(     \mathrm{feed\_ration\_fraction}_{}     \times     \mathrm{feed\_ef}_{}   \right) $$

title: Run the full Global Livestock Environmental Assessment Model (GLEAM) Pipeline — run_gleam
text: GLEAM package implements core computational engine Global Livestock Environmental Assessment Model (GLEAM), developed Food Agriculture Organization United Nations (FAO). provides modular workflow quantifying greenhouse gas emissions livestock systems using Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) approach based IPCC Tier 2 methodology. pipeline covers seven species (CTL, BFL, CML, SHP, GTS, PGS, CHK). Within herd, animals organised six demographic sex-age cohorts (FJ, FS, FA, MJ, MS, MA), optional non-demographic cohorts (FN, MN) non-demographic herd module used. identifiers used consistently across modules. assessment period specified days via simulation_duration (typically 365). Intermediate per-head-per-day variables carried cohort workflow scaled cohort herd totals final aggregation step. Every cohort productive phase must matching feed ration. pipeline stops lists missing combinations merging rations. inputs containing herd_id must refer herd set. Validation blocks variables expected produced internally.

text: has_herd_structure = FALSE, generate herd structure run_all_herd_module using selected run_demographic run_nondemographic switches; otherwise use supplied tables directly. Compute cohort weights (run_weights_module). Summarise ration quality (run_ration_quality_module) merge cohort table. Compute energy requirements dry matter intake (run_metabolic_energy_req_module). Compute enteric CH4 (run_emissions_enteric_module). Compute nitrogen balance (run_nitrogen_balance_module). Compute manure emissions (run_emissions_manure_module). Summarise feed production emissions (run_emissions_ration_module) merge cohort table. Compute production outputs (run_production_module). Compute allocation (run_allocation_module). Aggregate herd-level results CO2-eq (run_aggregation_module).

Pipeline runs herd # simulation first, then the rest of the pipeline. # The demographic module estimates diverted FN/MN to the non-demographic block. if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ path_run_gleam_examples <- system.file("extdata/run_gleam_examples", package = "gleam")  master_chrt_lvl_no_structure_dt <- data.table::fread(file.path(   path_run_gleam_examples, "master_chrt_lvl_no_structure_mixed_data.csv" )) master_hrd_lvl_dt <- data.table::fread(   file.path(path_run_gleam_examples, "master_hrd_lvl_mixed_data.csv") ) feed_rations_chrt_dt <- data.table::fread(   file.path(path_run_gleam_examples, "feed_rations_share_chrt.csv") ) feed_params_dt <- data.table::fread(system.file(   "extdata/run_gleam_examples/feed_quality.csv",   package = "gleam" )) feed_emissions_dt <- data.table::fread(system.file(   "extdata/run_gleam_examples/feed_emission_factors.csv",   package = "gleam" )) manure_management_system_fraction_dt <- data.table::fread(   file.path(path_run_gleam_examples, "manure_management_system_fraction.csv") ) manure_management_system_factors_dt <- data.table::fread(   file.path(path_run_gleam_examples, "manure_management_system_factors.csv") )  results <- run_gleam(   has_herd_structure = FALSE,   run_demographic = TRUE,   run_nondemographic = TRUE,   cohort_level_data = master_chrt_lvl_no_structure_dt,   herd_level_data = master_hrd_lvl_dt,   feed_rations = feed_rations_chrt_dt,   feed_params = feed_params_dt,   feed_emissions = feed_emissions_dt,   manure_management_system_fraction = manure_management_system_fraction_dt,   manure_management_system_factors = manure_management_system_factors_dt,   simulation_duration = 365 ) names(results) } # }  # Example 2: Non-demographic-only simulation of CHK layers and broilers. # The cohort file contains only FN/MN cohorts. if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ path_run_gleam_examples <- system.file("extdata/run_gleam_examples", package = "gleam")  master_chrt_lvl_no_structure_dt <- data.table::fread(file.path(   path_run_gleam_examples, "master_chrt_lvl_no_structure_nondemo_data.csv" )) master_hrd_lvl_dt <- data.table::fread(file.path(   path_run_gleam_examples, "master_hrd_lvl_nondemo_data.csv"   )) feed_rations_chrt_dt <- data.table::fread(   file.path(path_run_gleam_examples, "feed_rations_share_chrt_nondemo.csv") ) feed_params_dt <- data.table::fread(   file.path(path_run_gleam_examples, "feed_quality.csv") ) feed_emissions_dt <- data.table::fread(   file.path(path_run_gleam_examples, "feed_emission_factors.csv") ) manure_management_system_fraction_dt <- data.table::fread(file.path(   path_run_gleam_examples, "manure_management_system_fraction_nondemo.csv" )) manure_management_system_factors_dt <- data.table::fread(file.path(   path_run_gleam_examples, "manure_management_system_factors_nondemo.csv" ))  results <- run_gleam(   has_herd_structure = FALSE,   run_demographic = FALSE,   run_nondemographic = TRUE,   cohort_level_data = master_chrt_lvl_no_structure_dt,   herd_level_data = master_hrd_lvl_dt,   feed_rations = feed_rations_chrt_dt,   feed_params = feed_params_dt,   feed_emissions = feed_emissions_dt,   manure_management_system_fraction = manure_management_system_fraction_dt,   manure_management_system_factors = manure_management_system_factors_dt,   simulation_duration = 365,   show_indicator = TRUE ) names(results) } # }  # Example 3: You already HAVE herd structure — use cohort table and skip herd simulation. # Pipeline skips herd simulation and uses this as the starting cohort table. # The cohort file already supplies cohort_stock_size and offtake_heads_assessment. if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ path_run_gleam_examples <- system.file("extdata/run_gleam_examples", package = "gleam")  master_chrt_lvl_structure_dt <- data.table::fread(file.path(   path_run_gleam_examples, "master_chrt_lvl_structure_data.csv" )) master_hrd_lvl_dt <- data.table::fread( file.path(path_run_gleam_examples, "master_hrd_lvl_structure_data.csv") ) feed_rations_chrt_dt <- data.table::fread(file.path(   path_run_gleam_examples, "feed_rations_share_chrt.csv" )) feed_params_dt <- data.table::fread(file.path(   path_run_gleam_examples, "feed_quality.csv" )) feed_emissions_dt <- data.table::fread(file.path(   path_run_gleam_examples, "feed_emission_factors.csv" )) manure_management_system_fraction_dt <- data.table::fread(   file.path(path_run_gleam_examples, "manure_management_system_fraction.csv") ) manure_management_system_factors_dt <- data.table::fread(   file.path(path_run_gleam_examples, "manure_management_system_factors.csv") )  results <- run_gleam(   has_herd_structure = TRUE,   run_demographic = FALSE,   run_nondemographic = FALSE,   cohort_level_data = master_chrt_lvl_structure_dt,   herd_level_data = master_hrd_lvl_dt,   feed_rations = feed_rations_chrt_dt,   feed_params = feed_params_dt,   feed_emissions = feed_emissions_dt,   manure_management_system_fraction = manure_management_system_fraction_dt,   manure_management_system_factors = manure_management_system_factors_dt,   simulation_duration = 365,   show_indicator = FALSE ) names(results) } # title: Run the full Global Livestock Environmental Assessment Model (GLEAM) Pipeline — run_gleam
text: Runs full GLEAM pipeline master herd cohort inputs modules: herd (optional), weights, ration quality, energy requirements, manure emissions, enteric fermentation, nitrogren balance, feed emissions, allocation, aggregation. Common identifiers: Several input tables share following identifier columns. supported values listed referenced throughout. species_short — Character. Species code: CTL: Cattle BFL: Buffalo SHP: Sheep GTS: Goats PGS: Pigs CML: Camels CHK: Chickens cohort_short — Character. Sex- age-specific cohort code: FA: adult females (age first parturition) FS: sub-adult females (weaning age first parturition) FJ: juvenile females (birth weaning) MA: adult males (age first breeding) MS: sub-adult males (weaning age first breeding) MJ: juvenile males (birth weaning) FN: non-demographic females MN: non-demographic males

title: Run the full Global Livestock Environmental Assessment Model (GLEAM) Pipeline — run_gleam
text: has_herd_structure Logical. TRUE, cohort_level_data treated existing herd structure demographic herd simulation step skipped. FALSE, herd structure first generated cohort_level_data herd_level_data using run_all_herd_module, can run demographic herd module, non-demographic herd module, depending run_demographic run_nondemographic. run_demographic Logical. TRUE has_herd_structure = FALSE, include demographic herd module herd-structure generation step via run_all_herd_module. run_nondemographic Logical. TRUE has_herd_structure = FALSE, include non-demographic herd module herd-structure generation step via run_all_herd_module. cohort_level_data data.table. Cohort-level master input table. Required columns: herd_id Character. Unique herd identifier, repeated cohort within herd. species_short Character. Species code (see Common identifiers). cohort_short Character. Cohort code (see Common identifiers). cohort_duration_days Numeric. Time animal spends cohort (days). CHK, suggested value FJ MJ cohorts: 3 days. offtake_rate Numeric. Annual proportion animals removed herd per cohort (fraction). low_activity_fraction Numeric. Proportion assessment period low-intensity movement, e.g. stall-feeding near-field grazing (fraction). high_activity_fraction Numeric. Proportion assessment period sustained locomotion, e.g. herding long-distance grazing uneven terrain (fraction). Additional columns has_herd_structure = FALSE: death_rate Numeric. Annual fraction deaths per cohort (fraction). Required herd-simulation step. nondemo_productive_phase_id Numeric. non-demographic rows (FN, MN), productive phase identifier within non-demographic cycle. Allowed values 1 optionally 2. Additional columns has_herd_structure = TRUE: cohort_stock_size Numeric. Average population size cohort (heads). offtake_heads_assessment Numeric. Total animals removed via offtake assessment period per cohort (heads/assessment period). Optional column (cases): is_egg_producing Logical. Indicates whether cohort food-egg-producing chicken cohort. Used CHK; may TRUE FA FN laying phase 2. ch4_mitigation_factor Numeric. Multiplicative factor applied baseline enteric CH4 emissions (dimensionless). Defaults 1 (mitigation). Values < 1 represent proportional reductions (e.g. 0.90 = 10 percent reduction). Can represent feed additives methane inhibitors. herd_level_data data.table. Herd-level master input table (one row per herd_id). Required columns: herd_id Character. Unique herd identifier. species_short Character. Species code (see Common identifiers). live_weight_female_adult Numeric. Adult female live weight (kg). live_weight_male_adult Numeric. Adult male live weight (kg). live_weight_at_birth Numeric. Live weight birth (kg). live_weight_at_weaning Numeric. Live weight weaning (kg). live_weight_female_at_slaughter Numeric. Female sub-adult slaughter weight (kg). live_weight_male_at_slaughter Numeric. Male sub-adult slaughter weight (kg). age_first_parturition Numeric. Age first parturition (days). lactating_females_fraction Numeric. Proportion adult females lactating assessment period (fraction). Required CTL, BFL, CML, SHP, GTS. milk_yield_day Numeric. Average daily milk yield per milk-producing animal (kg/head/day), calculated total milk produced human consumption divided number milk-producing animals assessment period length. Required CTL, BFL, CML, SHP, GTS. milk_fat_fraction Numeric. Milk fat content (kg fat/kg milk). Required CTL, BFL, CML, SHP, GTS. milk_protein_fraction Numeric. Milk protein content (kg protein/kg milk). Required CTL, BFL, CML, SHP, GTS. milk_lactose_fraction Numeric. Milk lactose content (kg lactose/kg milk). Required CTL, BFL, CML, SHP, GTS. milk_protein_fraction_standard Numeric. Standard milk protein content FPCM calculation (kg protein/kg milk). Suggested: 0.033. milk_fat_fraction_standard Numeric. Standard milk fat content FPCM calculation (kg fat/kg milk). Suggested: 0.04. milk_lactose_fraction_standard Numeric. Standard milk lactose content FPCM calculation (kg lactose/kg milk). Suggested: 0.048. non_productive_duration Numeric. Period without productive function (pregnancy/lactation) (days). Required PGS. pregnancy_duration Numeric. Pregnancy duration (days). death_rate_juvenile Numeric. Annual death fraction juvenile cohorts (FJ, MJ) (fraction). lactation_duration Numeric. Lactation period length (days). Required PGS. parturition_rate Numeric. Average annual number parturitions per female animal (# parturitions/adult female/year). CHK, corresponds eggs laid reproduction FA , regardless food-egg flag. litter_size Numeric. Average number offspring produced per parturition (# offspring/parturition). CHK, can interpreted offspring produced per reproductive event. average_annual_temperature Numeric. Average annual temperature (degrees C). Used CHK. egg_average_weight Numeric. Average egg weight (kg/egg). Used CHK. egg_human_consumption_yield Numeric. Number eggs produced human consumption one year hen (eggs/year/animal). Used CHK. draught_work_hours_female Numeric. Average daily working time per adult female (hours/head/day). Required CTL, BFL, CML. draught_work_hours_male Numeric. Average daily working time per adult male (hours/head/day). Required CTL, BFL, CML. draught_fraction_female Numeric. Fraction adult females draught work (fraction). Required CTL, BFL, CML. draught_fraction_male Numeric. Fraction adult males draught work (fraction). Required CTL, BFL, CML. fibre_yield_year Numeric. Annual fibre production (wool, cashmere, mohair) (kg/head/year). Required CML, SHP, GTS. carcass_dressing_fraction Numeric. Carcass weight live weight ratio (fraction). bone_free_meat_fraction Numeric. Bone-free meat carcass weight ratio (fraction). meat_protein_fraction Numeric. Protein content bone-free meat (kg protein/kg bone-free meat). ratio_me_to_ne Numeric. Metabolizable--net energy ratio (fraction). Used CML. Suggested: 0.43. Additional columns has_herd_structure = FALSE: birth_fraction_female Numeric. Probability newborn female (fraction). herd_size_total Numeric. Total population start year, cohorts (heads). prop_nondemo_fem_juv Numeric. Fraction female juveniles diverted non-demographic stream moment transition next age class (fraction). Required demographic herd module run. prop_nondemo_mal_juv Numeric. Fraction male juveniles diverted non-demographic stream moment transition next age class (fraction). Required demographic herd module run. rest_between_nondemo_cycles_duration Numeric. Duration resting empty phase non-demographic cycles (days). Required non-demographic herd module run. phase1_nondemo_fem_duration_days Numeric. Duration productive phase 1 female non-demographic cohort (FN) (days). Required non-demographic herd module run herd-level phase durations. phase2_nondemo_fem_duration_days Numeric. Duration productive phase 2 female non-demographic cohort (FN) (days). phase1_nondemo_mal_duration_days Numeric. Duration productive phase 1 male non-demographic cohort (MN) (days). Required non-demographic herd module run herd-level phase durations. phase2_nondemo_mal_duration_days Numeric. Duration productive phase 2 male non-demographic cohort (MN) (days). feed_rations data.table. Cohort-level feed ration shares, also used run_ration_quality_module run_emissions_ration_module. Required columns: herd_id Character. Unique herd identifier. species_short Character. Species code (see Common identifiers). cohort_short Character. Cohort code (see Common identifiers). feed_id Character. Unique feed component identifier, used join key feed parameter tables. feed_name Character. Optional. Human-readable feed name; match feed_id uniquely provided. feed_ration_fraction Numeric. Proportion feed component total ration fraction diet dry matter intake (fraction). Must sum 1 within herd_id \(\times\) cohort combination. feed_params data.table. Feed nutritional parameters. Required columns: feed_id Character. Unique feed component identifier. feed_gross_energy Numeric. Gross energy: total chemical energy upon complete combustion (MJ/kg DM). feed_digestible_energy_ruminant Numeric. Digestible energy ruminants: energy absorbed faecal losses (MJ/kg DM). feed_digestible_energy_pigs Numeric. Digestible energy pigs (MJ/kg DM). feed_metabolizable_energy_ruminant Numeric. Metabolizable energy ruminants: digestible energy minus urinary gaseous losses (MJ/kg DM). feed_metabolizable_energy_pigs Numeric. Metabolizable energy pigs (MJ/kg DM). feed_metabolizable_energy_chicken Numeric. Metabolizable energy chickens: digestible energy minus uric acid gaseous losses (MJ/kg DM). feed_nitrogen_content Numeric. Nitrogen content (kg N/kg DM). feed_urinary_energy_ruminant Numeric. Fraction gross energy excreted urine ruminants (fraction). feed_urinary_energy_pigs Numeric. Fraction gross energy excreted urine pigs (fraction). feed_ash Numeric. Ash content fraction dry matter (g ash/100 g DM). category Character. Optional. Feed category; used consistently feed_id. feed_name Character. Optional. Human-readable feed name; match feed_id uniquely provided. feed_emissions data.table. Emission factors per feed component. emission factors expressed per kg feed dry matter intake. Required columns: feed_id Character. Unique feed component identifier. feed_name Character. Optional. Human-readable feed name. co2_feed_fertilizer Numeric. CO2 fertilizer manufacture (g CO2/kg DM). co2_feed_pesticides Numeric. CO2 pesticide manufacture (g CO2/kg DM). co2_feed_crop_activities Numeric. CO2 -field agricultural activities (g CO2/kg DM). co2_feed_luc_nopeat Numeric. CO2 land-use change, excluding peatland drainage (g CO2/kg DM). co2_feed_luc_peat Numeric. CO2 peatland drainage (g CO2/kg DM). n2o_feed_fertilizer Numeric. N2O fertilizer use (g N2O/kg DM). n2o_feed_manure_applied Numeric. N2O manure applied deposited soil (g N2O/kg DM). n2o_feed_crop_residues Numeric. N2O crop residue decomposition (g N2O/kg DM). ch4_feed_rice Numeric. CH4 rice cultivation (g CH4/kg DM). manure_management_system_fraction data.table. Cohort-level manure management system fractions passed run_emissions_manure_module. Required columns: herd_id Character. Unique herd identifier. cohort_short Character. Cohort code (see Common identifiers). manure_management_system Character. Manure management system name. mms_pasture mms_burned reserved manure deposited pasture burned fuel, respectively. systems grouped "". manure_management_system_fraction Numeric. Fraction total manure handled system herd \(\times\) cohort combination (0–1). Must sum 1 per herd_id. manure_management_system_factors data.table. Emission factors parameters per manure management system, passed run_emissions_manure_module. Required columns: manure_management_system Character. System name (see manure_management_system_fraction). ratio_m3CH4_to_kgCH4 Numeric. CH4 density conversion factor (kg/m3). Default: 0.67. methane_conversion_factor_mcf Numeric. Fraction maximum CH4-producing capacity (Bo) realised given management environmental conditions (0–1). See IPCC Table 10.17 (2006, 2019). ch4_max_producing_capacity_bo Numeric. Maximum CH4-producing capacity per unit volatile solids (m3 CH4/kg VS). Region- species-specific. See IPCC Table 10.16 (2019) Tables 10A-4 10A-9 (2006). n2o_ef3 Numeric. Direct N2O emission factor per manure management system (kg N2O-N/kg N). See IPCC Table 10.21 Table 11.1 (2006, 2019). n2o_ef4 Numeric. Indirect N2O emission factor atmospheric deposition volatilised N (kg N2O-N/(kg NH3-N + NOx-N)). See IPCC Table 11.3 (2006, 2019). nitrogen_fracgas Numeric. Fraction excreted N volatilised NH3 NOx collection, storage, treatment (0–1). See IPCC Table 10.22 (2006, 2019). n2o_ef5 Numeric. Indirect N2O emission factor leaching runoff (kg N2O-N/kg N). See IPCC Table 11.3 (2006, 2019). nitrogen_fracleach Numeric. Fraction excreted N lost leaching runoff (0–1). See IPCC Table 10.22 (2006, 2019). simulation_duration Numeric. Assessment period length (days). Used herd-simulation step (has_herd_structure = FALSE) run_all_herd_module, production aggregation steps. Default: 365. global_warming_potential_set Character. GWP-100 conversion factors expressing CH4 N2O CO2-eq. One : "AR6": IPCC 6th Assessment (2021) — CH4 = 27, N2O = 273. "AR5_excluding_carbon_feedback": IPCC 5th Assessment, excl. climate-carbon feedbacks (2013) — CH4 = 28, N2O = 265. "AR5_including_carbon_feedback": IPCC 5th Assessment, incl. climate-carbon feedbacks (2013) — CH4 = 34, N2O = 298. "AR4": IPCC 4th Assessment (2007) — CH4 = 25, N2O = 298. show_indicator Logical. Whether display progress indicators calculations. Defaults TRUE.

text: named list four elements: cohort_level_results cohort-level data.table containing original input columns plus variables generated across pipeline. Calculated variables grouped module. herd_level_results herd-level data.table. has_herd_structure = FALSE, output run_all_herd_module may therefore contain: growth_rate_herd Numeric. Annualized growth rate herd reaches steady state (fraction). Returned demographic herd module run. cohort_stock_fem_annual_nondemo Numeric. Annual number female animals entering non-demographic pathway (FN) simulated period (# heads / simulated period). cohort_stock_mal_annual_nondemo Numeric. Annual number male animals entering non-demographic pathway (MN) simulated period (# heads / simulated period). rest_between_nondemo_cycles_duration Numeric. Duration resting empty phase non-demographic cycles (days). total_nondemo_fem_duration_days Numeric. Total duration productive non-demographic phases assigned female non-demographic cohort block (FN) (days). total_nondemo_mal_duration_days Numeric. Total duration productive non-demographic phases assigned male non-demographic cohort block (MN) (days). has_herd_structure = TRUE, supplied herd_level_data returned unchanged. allocation_long herd-level data.table long format one row per herd \(\times\) commodity \(\times\) emission source: herd_id Character. Herd identifier. species_short Character. Species code. variable_name Character. Emission variable name (e.g. "ch4_enteric", "n2o_manure_pasture_direct"). commodity_name Character. Commodity category: one "None", "Milk", "Meat", "Fibre", "Work", "Eggs". commodity_type Character. "Edible" "Non-Edible". allocation_share Numeric. Allocation share commodity-emission combination (fraction). aggregation_results named list run_aggregation_module elements results_emissions, results_feed, results_production, results_nitrogen. tables summarise herd-level emissions, feed intake, production, nitrogen balance, scaled assessment duration.

title: Run the full Global Livestock Environmental Assessment Model (GLEAM) Pipeline — run_gleam
text: GLEAM package implements core computational engine Global Livestock Environmental Assessment Model (GLEAM), developed Food Agriculture Organization United Nations (FAO). provides modular workflow quantifying greenhouse gas emissions livestock systems using Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) approach based IPCC Tier 2 methodology. pipeline covers seven species (CTL, BFL, CML, SHP, GTS, PGS, CHK). Within herd, animals organised six demographic sex-age cohorts (FJ, FS, FA, MJ, MS, MA), optional non-demographic cohorts (FN, MN) non-demographic herd module used. identifiers used consistently across modules. assessment period specified days via simulation_duration (typically 365). Intermediate per-head-per-day variables carried cohort workflow scaled cohort herd totals final aggregation step. Every cohort productive phase must matching feed ration. pipeline stops lists missing combinations merging rations. inputs containing herd_id must refer herd set. Validation blocks variables expected produced internally.

title: Run the full Global Livestock Environmental Assessment Model (GLEAM) Pipeline — run_gleam
text: has_herd_structure = FALSE, generate herd structure run_all_herd_module using selected run_demographic run_nondemographic switches; otherwise use supplied tables directly. Compute cohort weights (run_weights_module). Summarise ration quality (run_ration_quality_module) merge cohort table. Compute energy requirements dry matter intake (run_metabolic_energy_req_module). Compute enteric CH4 (run_emissions_enteric_module). Compute nitrogen balance (run_nitrogen_balance_module). Compute manure emissions (run_emissions_manure_module). Summarise feed production emissions (run_emissions_ration_module) merge cohort table. Compute production outputs (run_production_module). Compute allocation (run_allocation_module). Aggregate herd-level results CO2-eq (run_aggregation_module).

title: Run Metabolic Energy Requirements and Dry Matter Intake Module Pipeline — run_metabolic_energy_req_module
text: function joins cohort_level_data herd_level_data herd_id, uses species_short directly species-specific energy calculations, computes IPCC Tier 2 energy partition components derived feed intake metrics cohort. Energy requirements expressed : Net energy CTL, BFL, SHP, GTS. Metabolizable energy CML PGS. function represents intermediate module Global Livestock Environmental Assessment Model (GLEAM) computational pipeline run_gleam() estimate animals' metabolic energy requirements dry matter intake performs following calculation sequence: Maintenance energy computed using calc_metabolic_energy_req_maintenance. Activity energy computed using calc_metabolic_energy_req_activity. Growth energy computed using calc_metabolic_energy_req_growth. Lactation energy computed using calc_metabolic_energy_req_lactation. Work energy computed using calc_metabolic_energy_req_work. Fibre production energy computed using calc_metabolic_energy_req_fibre. Pregnancy energy computed using calc_metabolic_energy_req_pregnancy. Diet net energy ratios computed using calc_rem_maintenance calc_reg_growth (ruminants ). Total daily energy requirement computed using calc_total_metabolic_energy_req. Daily dry matter intake computed using calc_ration_intake.

text: cohort_level_data data.table. Cohort-level input table (one row per herd-cohort) following data requirement: herd_id Character. Unique identifier herd, repeated cohort belonging herd. cohort_short Character. Sex- age-specific cohort code describing production stage animals. Supported values include: FA: adult females (age first parturition) FS: sub-adult females (weaning age first parturition) FJ: juvenile females (birth weaning) FN: non-demographic females MA: adult males (age first breeding) MS: sub-adult males (weaning age first breeding) MJ: juvenile males (birth weaning) MN: non-demographic males nondemo_productive_phase_id Numeric. Optional productive phase identifier non-demographic cohorts (FN, MN). present, production outputs retained separately phase. is_egg_producing Logical. Indicates whether cohort food-egg-producing chicken cohort. Used CHK; may TRUE FA FN laying phase 2. cohort_stock_size Numeric. Average population size assessed cohort (# heads). offtake_heads_assessment Numeric. Total number animals removed via offtake assessment period assessed cohort (# heads / assessment period). live_weight_cohort_at_slaughter Numeric. Live weight slaughter animals removed cohort (kg). herd_level_data data.table. Herd-level input table (one row per herd_id) following data requirement. Milk-related columns fibre_yield_year may omitted cohort table contains FN MN: herd_id Character. Unique identifier herd, repeated cohort belonging herd. species_short Character. Code identifying livestock species. Supported values include: PGS: pigs CML: camels CTL: cattle BFL: buffalo SHP: sheep GTS: goats CHK: chickens milk_yield_day Numeric. Average milk yield per milk-producing animal assessment duration (kg/head/day). value calculated total quantity milk produced human consumption milk-producing animals assessment period, divided number milk-producing animals, length assessment period (days). Required species = CML, CTL, BFL, SHP, GTS. lactating_females_fraction Numeric. Proportion adult females lactating assessment period (fraction). Required species: CML, CTL, BFL, SHP, GTS. milk_protein_fraction Numeric. Milk protein fraction (kg protein/kg milk). Required species = CML, CTL, BFL, SHP, GTS. milk_fat_fraction Numeric. Milk fat fraction (kg fat/kg milk). Required species = CML, CTL, BFL, SHP, GTS. milk_lactose_fraction Numeric. Milk lactose fraction (kg lactose/kg milk). Required species = CML, CTL, BFL, SHP, GTS. milk_protein_fraction_standard Numeric. Standard protein content milk, used calculate Fat-protein-corrected milk (FPCM), (kg protein/kg milk). Suggested value = 0.033. milk_fat_fraction_standard Numeric. Standard fat content milk, used calculate Fat-protein-corrected milk (FPCM), (kg fat/kg milk). Suggested value = 0.04. milk_lactose_fraction_standard Numeric. Standard lactose content milk, used calculate Fat-protein-corrected milk (FPCM), (kg lactose/kg milk). Suggested value = 0.048. egg_human_consumption_yield Numeric. Number eggs produced human consumption one year hen (eggs/year/animal). Used CHK. egg_average_weight Numeric. Average egg weight (kg/egg). Used CHK. fibre_yield_year Numeric. Annual production yield fibre, wool, cashmere, mohair (kg/head/year). Required species = CML, SHP, GTS. carcass_dressing_fraction Numeric. Ratio slaughtered animal's carcass weight live weight (fraction). bone_free_meat_fraction Numeric. Ratio bone-free-meat carcass weight (fraction). meat_protein_fraction Numeric. Protein content bone-free-meat (kg protein/kg bone-free-meat). simulation_duration Numeric. Length assessment period (days). show_indicator Logical. Whether display progress indicators simulation. Defaults TRUE.

title: Run Production Module Pipeline — run_production_module
text: function represents intermediate module Global Livestock Environmental Assessment Model (GLEAM) computational pipeline run_gleam() estimate meat, milk, fibre, eggs production outputs livestock performs following calculation sequence: Milk outputs computed using calc_milk_production Fibre outputs computed using calc_fibre_production Meat outputs computed using calc_meat_production Eggs outputs computed using calc_egg_production species/cohorts milk, fibre egg production applicable, outputs returned zero. Food-egg output calculated egg_human_consumption_yield (eggs/year/animal), multiplied stock flagged cohort scaled assessment period. Reproductive eggs FA excluded food-egg production.

text: rations_share data.table. Cohort-level feed ration composition shares following minimum data requirement: herd_id Character. Unique identifier herd, repeated cohort belonging herd. species_short Character. Code identifying livestock species.
