title: Run Ration Quality Module Pipeline — run_ration_quality_module
text: data.table. Cohort-level nutritional metrics summarized herd_id, species_short, cohort_short, nondemo_productive_phase_id present, following columns: ration_gross_energy Numeric. Average gross energy content diet (MJ/kg DM). ration_metabolizable_energy Numeric. Average metabolizable energy content diet (MJ/kg DM). ration_nitrogen Numeric. Average nitrogen content diet (kg N/kg DM). ration_digestibility_fraction Numeric. Average digestibility feed ration, expressed ratio digestible (metabolizable, chickens) gross energy content (fraction). ration_urinary_energy_fraction Numeric. Fraction feed's gross energy excreted urine (fraction). ration_ash Numeric. Average ash content feed, calculated fraction dry matter intake (kg ash/kg DM).

title: Run Ration Quality Module Pipeline — run_ration_quality_module
text: function represents intermediate module Global Livestock Environmental Assessment Model (GLEAM) computational pipeline run_gleam() estimate nutritional quality feed ration. function joins rations_share feed_params feed_id, uses species_short directly, computes ration-weighted nutritional metrics cohort. chickens, digestibility calculated using chicken metabolizable energy divided gross energy. Urinary energy set zero losses already included metabolizable energy. following calculation sequence applied: Species-specific digestibility ratios computed energy parameters feed_gross_energy using calc_feed_digestibility_fraction. Contributions feed component computed ration-weighted values: gross energy using calc_ration_gross_energy nitrogen using calc_ration_nitrogen_content digestibility using calc_ration_digestibility metabolizable energy using calc_ration_metabolizable_energy urinary energy fraction using calc_ration_urinary_energy_fraction ash using calc_ration_ash Cohort-level nutritional metrics obtained whole feed ration summing contributions across feed components within herd_id, species_short, cohort_short group, within nondemo_productive_phase_id column provided.

title: Run Weights Module Pipeline — run_weights_module
text: cohort_level_data data.table long format one row per herd \(\times\) cohort. Must include: herd_id Character. Unique identifier herd, repeated cohort belonging herd. cohort_short Character. Sex- age-specific cohort code describing production stage animals. Supported values include: FA: adult females (age first parturition) FS: sub-adult females (weaning age first parturition) FJ: juvenile females (birth weaning) MA: adult males (age first breeding) MS: sub-adult males (weaning age first breeding) MJ: juvenile males (birth weaning) FN: non-demographic females MN: non-demographic males cohort_duration_days Numeric. Amount time animal spends specific cohort (days). CHK, suggested value FJ MJ cohorts: 3 days. offtake_rate Numeric. Annual proportion animals removed herd sex-age cohort (fraction). Optional column: nondemo_productive_phase_id Numeric. Productive phase identifier non-demographic cohorts (FN, MN). Allowed values 1 optionally 2. Demographic cohorts use NA. herd_level_data data.table one row per herd. Must include: herd_id Character. Unique identifier herd. species_short Character. Code identifying livestock species. Supported values include: PGS: pigs CML: camels CTL: cattle BFL: buffalo SHP: sheep GTS: goats CHK: chickens live_weight_female_adult Numeric. Live weight adult males (kg), required male demographic cohorts (MJ, MS, MA) present. live_weight_at_birth Numeric. Live weight animal weaning (kg), required juvenile demographic cohorts (FJ, MJ) present. live_weight_female_at_slaughter Numeric. Slaughter weight female sub-adult animals (kg), required FS present. live_weight_male_at_slaughter Numeric. Slaughter weight male sub-adult animals (kg), required MS present. live_weight_female_nondemographic_start Numeric. Live weight beginning female non-demographic cycle (kg), FN present. live_weight_female_nondemographic_end Numeric. Live weight end female non-demographic cycle (kg), FN present. live_weight_male_nondemographic_start Numeric. Live weight beginning male non-demographic cycle (kg), MN present. live_weight_male_nondemographic_end Numeric. Live weight end male non-demographic cycle (kg), MN present. phase1_nondemo_fem_duration_days Numeric. Productive phase 1 duration FN (days), FN present. phase2_nondemo_fem_duration_days Numeric. title: Run Weights Module Pipeline — run_weights_module
text: named list two data.tables: cohort_level_results input cohort_level_data additional columns: live_weight_mature_stage Numeric. Mature (adult) live weight animal can attain given biological management conditions (kg). live_weight_cohort_initial Numeric. Live weight beginning cohort stage (kg). live_weight_cohort_potential_final Numeric. Potential final live weight attainable end cohort stage absence offtake (kg). (juveniles: equals weaning weight; subadults: equals adult live weight; adults: equals adult live weight) live_weight_cohort_at_slaughter Numeric. Live weight slaughter animals removed cohort (kg). live_weight_cohort_average Numeric. Average live weight cohort stage. Computed accounting share offtaken animals within cohort, using slaughter weight, potential final weight animals remain cohort (kg). live_weight_cohort_final Numeric. Live weight end cohort stage, accounting surviving offtaken animals. Computed weighted average potential final weight surviving animals slaughter weight offtaken animals, based offtake rate (kg). daily_weight_gain Numeric. Average live weight gain cohort cohort stage (kg/head/day). herd_level_results copy input herd_level_data.

title: Run Weights Module Pipeline — run_weights_module
text: Species read herd_level_data$species_short, matched cohort rows herd_id. Demographic weight columns may omitted cohort table contains FN MN; weights come non-demographic start/end weights phase durations. function represents intermediate module Global Livestock Environmental Assessment Model (GLEAM) computational pipeline run_gleam() estimate animals' live weight composed following steps: Cohort-stage weight assignment using calc_cohort_weights. Herd-level biological parameters matched cohort row herd_id via data.table joins. non-demographic cohorts (FN, MN), function uses nondemo_productive_phase_id together herd-level start/end live weights phase durations assign phase-specific initial final weights. Calculation average final live weights (accounting offtake) using calc_avg_weights. non-demographic cohorts, offtake_rate ignored final weight equals phase-specific potential final weight. Calculation average daily live weight gain using calc_daily_weight_gain.
